ev.q: Xena is a historical fantasy set primarily in ancient Greece
Historical figures and events from several different historical eras and myths
from whimsical and musical to all-out action and adventure
from high melodrama to slapstick comedy
Critics have praised the series for its strong female protagonist
A subject of much interest and debate among viewers is the question of whether Xena and Gabrielle are lovers
the series finale aired in the summer of 2001
